We need to use latest version of https://github.com/link-foundation/browser-commander and make sure we can use our scripts/commands to actually read article not only from viewer, but also from editor, so when converted back from editor to markdown we can show a diff in terminal or export diff to file. And we should be able to prefill the draft to editor of article in habr, so we are able to do minimum changes in editor, to reproduce the same content as in markdown files of our latest draft or any selected draft.

But don't automatically send without an explicit CLI options, so we go with risk free approach, yet support sync in all full features.
